title: A palette next to your own clothes
description: Color combinations are tested on familiar clothes and compared with the original.

blocks.text: A large number of palettes can leave a person with the same question: which of these to apply.

quote.text: I was completely surprised by the color analysis. After all this time, I thought I knew my best color palette but was completely wrong. So glad I discovered this app!

blocks.text: Pick a few shades, show them on specific combinations and leave a comparison that is easy to read. Save the options someone liked.
The lighting in a photo affects color. Supporting a personal choice is more useful than declaring a single correct palette.
